topic: Spec as Single Source of Truth (I1)
evidence: I1 (SPEC IS SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH): every execution is grounded in spec. Phase ordering: P1 (spec) must be locked before P2 (plan); P2 must be locked before P3 (execute). Guard enforces this via receipt chain — no execution without specify-receipt and decompose-receipt. Spec is the task card: .wabblespec/plans/task-card.md. EARS-syntax requirements in task card are the ground truth. Executor produces exactly what the spec declares — no more, no less. BREAKING deviation discovered mid-wave: stop, surface, loop back to Specify before continuing. framework.yaml is the spec for module existence and structure. .wabblespec/VERSION is the spec for framework version. CHANGELOG is the spec for what changed and when.
